title: Reduce governance debt and restore small-team throughput

preflight.note: Before implementation, verified main at b9dec03ad59c2ef7d782eda9f2b3220747e8ba3c and open draft PR #29 at daa94e8ddc264212a7e1c372b5c935c95c522ab5, which contains the proposed WI082. Created WI083 through the canonical Rust-engine work.create path on a detached local worktree of that exact candidate so the allocator skipped WI082; only the generated WI083 directory is carried to this main-based branch, and no PR #29 branch change was made. Implementation had not started.

acceptance_criteria.text: Capture matched before/after counts and elapsed time for the shipped tutorial path and selected existing verification operations, with exact source, commands, environment, and failures. Distinguish command reduction from a productivity or effectiveness claim.

Remove redundant verification invocations from the shipped tutorial and align new-repository instructions. Keep preflight after intent is recorded and current-state validation after governed ledger or evidence changes; explain when an already-passed declared check remains valid for the same relevant candidate.

Use one validated verification contract/profile selection per invocation where safe. Preserve actual report/journal steps and fail-closed behavior for invalid or drifting policy, unknown profiles, unavailable required steps, interruption, and evidence-capture errors; add focused regression coverage for recorded and unrecorded default and explicit profiles.

Measure ordinary mutation candidate snapshot/copy work. Implement a bounded reduction only if it preserves complete diagnostics, Git/worktree facts, stale read-set checks, frozen-surface checks, rollback, cleanup, and independent live post-state validation; otherwise record the measured blocker and defer the structural optimization.

Preserve declared CI coverage, the required legacy comparator, independent frozen checks, honest start/end candidate identities, negative outcomes, and transaction behavior. Regenerate governed artifacts and link exact local validation evidence without editing protected surfaces.

Reuse WI022 comparative framework and the unrun WI082 research proposal where applicable. Record a matched evaluation protocol and thresholds before any study; leave unavailable or unauthorized comparative efficacy evidence explicitly pending and make no causal or productivity claim from one case.
